lying.definition: n. the deliberate act of deviating from the truth
lying.translation:
n. 说谎
a. 横躺的, 说谎的

lying in grant.translation: [法] 依授与文据转移处理

lying in wait.translation: [法] 埋伏, 伏击, 诡计

lying in wake.definition:
When a spouse or girlfriend/boyfriend pretends to be asleep when you get home after a late night out, so they can tear you a new one when you wake up.
> I tried to slip into bed last night without Megan noticing, but it turns out she was lying in wake. She told me this morning when she was chewing my ass.

lying-in.definition: n concluding state of pregnancy; from the onset of contractions to the birth of a child
lying-in.translation:
n. 临盆, 生产, 分娩
[医] 产期, 产后的

lying-ins.definition: n concluding state of pregnancy; from the onset of contractions to the birth of a child

lyingly.definition: adv. In a lying manner; falsely.
lyingly.translation: adv. 虚伪地, 说着谎地

lyings-in.definition: n concluding state of pregnancy; from the onset of contractions to the birth of a child
